Definition: Nun or Non, the father of Joshua
BiblicalUsage: Nun is the father of Joshua, and his name is attached to his son's in nearly every mention, Joshua the son of Nun. In Numbers 13:16 Moses renames Oshea the son of Nun as Jehoshua when he sends him to spy out the land, and in Joshua 1:1 the Lord speaks to Joshua the son of Nun after the death of Moses.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a father's name can outlive him in his son's story, and Nun is remembered because Joshua was faithful.
RelatedEvents: The Twelve Spies and Israel's Unbelief; Joshua Commissioned to Lead Israel
